CU44PaidKept.dc.html.note: The board is approved and pixel exact (0 px at threshold 8). The control behind it is wrong. paid-store.ts's effect treats a kept payment as recorded as soon as its id leaves the outbox (`if (!p.kept || !p.keptId || ids.has(p.keptId)) return; putPaid({...p, kept:false}); sendReceipt(...)`). But outbox.discard() also removes it. So if Grace throws a refused or kept payment away (from Today's not-sent list), Paid turns to 'Paid' and Kato is sent a receipt 'paid 420,000 · Owes now 0' for money that was never booked. Fix: flip to Paid and send the receipt only on a successful send. Have the outbox report what it sent (flush() already counts sent; expose the sent ids, or an onSent(id) listener) and act on those ids alone. On a discard, set the receipt 'off' and the entry 'not recorded'. Also: a kept payment the server refuses stays 'Records when signal comes back' forever. Outbox Q5 says a refused write is shown with the server's reason; show it here, with its fix or discard. Board note: the slip's green ticks on unrecorded lines (review file). Try again now shows 'Trying…' and then the toast.
